summary: SiteDocument manages documents associated with a site, providing a model for document storage and retrieval. Documents are tied to a SiteID and have an ID for identification.
purpose: To represent and manage documents linked to sites in the system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument is a sealed class; documents linked by SiteID and ID; used in data layer logic.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a landing page and interface for staff administrators, including date filtering, dropdowns for Site and Discipline, and facilities for viewing and managing employment applications.
purpose: To provide staff administrators a dashboard for viewing key application data, filtering by site, discipline, and date, and managing status.

workflows.name: Application Filtering and View
steps: StaffAdmin logs in and lands on WelcomeStaffAdmin page.
Dropdowns for Site and Discipline presented; filtering by Start and End Date.
Data grid shows employment applications; withdrawn applications toggle.
Row data bound for email, status, withdrawn date.
View can be updated by changing dropdowns or date fields.

validations: RequiredFieldValidator for Start and End dates.
CustomValidator to ensure StartDate is not after EndDate.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
Show warning/error panels if errors are present.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields are present for UI controls.
RefreshData is called on filter changes.
Dropdowns are populated via FillSiteDropdown and FillDisciplineDropdown.
Page messages and JavaScript setup on render.

summary: ServiceCode represents a categorized code for services provided, supporting alternate language fields and retrieval by course or timetable.
purpose: To provide a systematic coding and categorization for services, including localization.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Retrieval
steps: Localize: Replace Name field with NameAlt if alternate language mode is enabled.

business_rules: Use alternate language fields when Sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true.
system_behavior: ServiceCode is a sealed class.
ServiceCodes is a static class for batch retrieval and localization.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks historical changes to site profiles, including action dates, sections changed, user actions, user details, and conditions for displaying supporting team information.
purpose: To provide an audit trail and formatted details for changes to site profiles, including who made the change and what was altered.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistory Retrieval
steps: SiteProfileHistorySearch: Retrieve history by SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
FillList: Populate SiteProfileHistory entity from database record.

business_rules: Display HSPnet Support Team info when ByUserSysAdmin is false and user IDs do not match.
conditions: If Phone is non-empty, include in tooltip.
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistories is a sealed class with retrieval/search logic.
UserControls.SiteProfileHistory expects UserSession and SiteID properties.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents documents used in email popups, tracking filename, file path, and checked status. Supports searching and deleting popup documents by parsing the data string.
purpose: To manage email-related documents for popup display and deletion.

workflows.name: Search and Delete EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Search: Parse DataInfo string, create EmailPopupDocument instances per valid entry.
Delete: Remove file and folder for document with matching ID, rebuild DataInfo string.

business_rules: Valid entries require FileName and FilePath.
Delete cleans up both file and folder if possible.
system_behavior: Search parses a delimited string, splits into documents.
Delete removes file/folder and updates the DataInfo string.
exceptions: File/Directory deletion exceptions are caught and ignored.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents batches of expenses per department, including codes, descriptions, dates, and status. Supports adding, updating, searching, and deletion operations.
purpose: To manage and track batches of expenses, their status, and associated metadata.
business_rules: StatusDescription uses alternate language if UseAltLanguageFields is set.
system_behavior: ExpenseBatch is a sealed class; ExpenseBatches is a static manager class.

summary: CostCentre manages records for placement cost centers, supporting filtering by various placement attributes and storing rich metadata including agencies, discipline, finances, and student hours.
purpose: To provide detailed cost center records for placements, enabling financial and administrative reporting.

workflows.name: CostCentre Retrieval
steps: GetCostCentre: Retrieve records by parameters (sessionID, dates, agencies, discipline, etc.).
FillList: Populate CostCentreRecord from database values.

system_behavior: CostCentreView.GetCostCentre filters and retrieves cost center records.
CostCentreRecord is a POCO with XML mapping.

summary: TimetableAssessments manages student assessment schedules, including workflows for adding, editing, deleting assessments, validations for dates, and rules for assessor/subject roles. Provides custom popups for editing assessments and tracks rotation existence.
purpose: To enable management of scheduled assessments for students, including detailed assessor/subject configuration, templates, and validations.

workflows.name: Assessment Management
steps: Show all assessments for a timetable.
Allow/deny viewing of answers as per roles.
On add/edit, update database and refresh grid.

business_rules: Interim assessment cannot exist without a final.
Instructors and supervisors cannot both be assessors for the same assessment.
Assessment maximum must not be exceeded.
calculations: Days after placement start/end for assessment open/close.
conditions: Editable only for system admins or local admins.
Optional sections shown per templates and roles.
PnlEmptyData visible if no rows and editable.
system_behavior: GridView binds assessments, provides popup for add/edit.
JavaScript manages UI logic for roles and templates.
Validation and error panels display issues.
exceptions: Errors for interim without final, role conflicts, assessment maximum exceeded.

summary: AdHocQuery provides methods to render SQL query results as HTML tables, supporting header, row, and footer formatting.
purpose: To transform database query results into HTML tables for display.

workflows.name: Render Data Reader as HTML Table
steps: DataReaderToHTMLTable: Calls HeaderRow, DataRow for each record, FooterRow for completion.
DataRow: Generates <td> elements per column, handles nulls.

system_behavior: For each database row, values converted to HTML table cells.
Null values are displayed as 'NULL'.

summary: StudentPrerequisites manages and tracks student prerequisites for placements, including immunizations, mask fitting, confidentiality forms, and medical details. Provides business logic and validations for expiry dates, status codes, and administrative updates.
purpose: To ensure students meet health, safety, and compliance prerequisites for placement, and support update workflows.
business_rules: Fit Test expiry cannot be more than 5 years in future.
Immunization dates and medical completion cannot be more than 5 years in future.
Year fields must be in valid range (MIN_YEAR to MaxYear).
Dates must be valid and not NullDate for mandatory fields.
Expiry date must be after fit test date if both are specified.
Consent program and dates are required for confidentiality.
validations: IsValid checks for date ranges, required fields, and field logic.
calculations: Expiry dates computed based on admin date when not specified.
Status code descriptions formatted for display/print.
system_behavior: StudentPrerequisite is a sealed class with extensive field mapping.
StudentPrerequisites is a static manager class for search and update.
Methods support not only update but validation and error message handling.
exceptions: Validation errors for date/fields show error messages.
